[[Stumbling | Stumbling VIII]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Stumbling | Stumbling VIII]]:''' On Hit: Your target suffers a -1 Penalty to [[Reflex]] Saving Throws for 6 seconds. This effect stacks up to 5 times. This effect may only occur on-hit once every three seconds.
Passive: The DC of the saving throw to resist your [[Trip]] combat feats is increased by 13.
